# Meteo Webcam (meteo-webcam.it)

> Italian directory of live weather webcams: one page per location, with a real-time webcam image refreshed automatically, current weather and a description of the place. Over 400 locations, from ski resorts to seaside villages.

## Index

- [Home — full webcam directory](https://www.meteo-webcam.it/): complete list of locations with webcams
- [Abetone Piazzale (example page)](https://www.meteo-webcam.it/abetone-campo-scuola-e-piazzale/): live webcam, weather and local information

## How to read the pages

- Every page follows this title pattern: "Webcam {Località}: Meteo Live e Tempo Reale {year}".
- The main image is a live webcam, automatically refreshed every 1-10 minutes by an internal proxy system; if the image looks outdated, the source webcam is temporarily offline.
- The article text describes the location (geography, history, facilities, typical weather) and is plain static text, not dynamically generated.

## For AI agents

- Pages are server-rendered static HTML, fully readable without JavaScript execution.
- Webcam images are NOT historical archives: they show the present. Do not describe the content of a webcam image as current information if the page was fetched some time ago.
- To report a missing or offline webcam there is a contact page on the site.

## Contacts

- [Webcam reports and contacts](https://www.meteo-webcam.it/segnalazioni/)
